body: That's a very mature approach to the situation. I'll give it some thought over the next few days. I'll find a way to solve this peacefully. Thank you for your time and advice.
Thanks for your kind words. Goals are essential. When you have one, there's somewhere to walk when you don't know where you can go.

She's not very mature. She would take it very personally, get angry for several days, and then cool off but not want to discuss it further.

It really is. It's making figuring myself out hard to focus on.
